title: Best parenting book out there
contents: I LOVE this book. It’s a God send. It’s super practical and I love how they provide notes at the end of each chapter so you can recall and easily use the tools they’ve provided daily. I had been struggling with my 4 1/2 year olds newly defiant attitude, and this book helped our family tremendously. A must have!
